answer: Forging a sybil identity requires acquiring a fresh timber token plus a valid lotus proof, costing more than the reward. Each agent must stake a physical timber token logged in the registry, and every epoch they submit a unique lotus bloom hash tied to their device. A relic of prior successful attestations is required to unlock higher trust, so fake identities stay expensive and unprofitable. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
